AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: An Improved YOLOv8 and OC-SORT Framework for Fish Counting
REGION: Dongshan, China (Coral Ecosystem Cabled Observatory, CECO)
SPECIES: 19 reef fish species (e.g., Neopomacentrus violascens >10,000 annotations; Stephanolepis cirrhifer 12)
DATA: Own CECO cabled-observatory frames (>40,000 annotated fish, several thousand frames) for detection; one ~5-min 1080p 30 FPS video annotated in MOT17 format for tracking
V_EV: Sec. 4: 'performance under varying environmental conditions—such as water turbidity and suspended sediment concentration—has not been quantitatively evaluated'
D2: 80/10/10 stratified by species (detection); single separate video for tracking
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'stratified sampling was used to divide the dataset into training, validation, and test sets ... 80% training set ... 10% validation set ... 10% test set'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The dataset used for object detection consists of fish images captured by Coral EcosystemCabled Observatory (CECO) in Dongshan, China' (single source)
C_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'Byte-OCSORT achieves the highest MOTA (72.3) and IDF1 (69.4) while significantly reducing ID switches to 16'; detection threshold value not reported
E_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'Although we did not explicitly compute species-specific classification or counting errors' — only mAP and MOTA/IDF1 reported
ARCH: YOLOv8-DT (YOLOv8n + DLKA CSP + TDFI modules) detector; Byte-OCSORT tracker (OC-SORT + BYTE two-stage matching + class cost matrix); track-ID counting
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50:95, APs (small); MOTA, IDF1, ID switches
NOTE: Detection split is species-stratified random at image/frame level from observatory footage (no video/day separation; leakage not discussed) -> D_ALL=N. Tracking evaluated on one separate 5-min video from same observatory (not external). C5: explicit ID-switch handling and reporting in tracking; high/low confidence thresholds exist for BYTE association but values not reported -> C1=NR -> C_ALL=P (if threshold mention counted as C1=Y, C_ALL would be Y). Despite 'fish counting' framing, no count output vs human counts is reported (authors state counting errors not computed) -> E1=없음. E4='크기별' from APs (small objects). Model trained from scratch (PRE=없음). Data unavailable due to privacy restrictions.
